SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT PLANT , PO_NO , PO_LNNO , STATUS FROM V_KEP_PO WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY PLANT, PO_NO, PO_LNNO
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'SDSM' AS BUYER , 'KA' AS SITE , PLANT , PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO , PO_LNNO AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ , '00' AS REVISION , STATUS AS STATUS , MAT_CD AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , PRCH_UNT_PR AS UNIT_PRICE , PO_QTY AS ITEM_QTY , PO_AMT AS ITEM_AMT , PO_CFDT_LAST AS ADD_DATE , SHPG_DUE_DT AS RD_DATE , ARVL_CD AS DELY_TO_LOCATION , PURCHASER_USER_ID AS PURCHASER_USER_ID , POR_NO||'-'||POR_LNNO AS LEGACY_PR_NO , REQ_USER_ID AS REQ_USER_ID , REQ_USER_NAME AS REQ_USER_NAME , REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME AS REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME , PO_LINE_RMRK AS REMARK , MAT_RCV_EMP_NM||'^'||POR_DESC||'^'||PROJ_NO||'^'||UNT_WT||'^'|| WT||'^'||WGT_UNT_PR||'^'||PO_REV_NO||'^'||BLK_ZONE||'^'|| PND||'^'||POR_REV_NO||'^' AS IV_COLUMN FROM V_KEP_PO WHERE PLANT = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND PO_LNNO = '$G_RS.PO_LNNO$' ORDER BY PLANT, PO_NO, PO_LNNO
UPDATE V_KEP_PO SET IF_FLAG = 'Y' , IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE PLANT = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND PO_LNNO = '$G_RS.PO_LNNO$'
UPDATE V_KEP_PO SET IF_FLAG = 'E' , IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE PLANT = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND PO_LNNO = '$G_RS.PO_LNNO$'
